tools.name: generate
tools.args: portal_id: str, prompt: str, method_name: str, shot_id: str = "-1", ref_images: list[str] | None = None, style: str | None = None, video_path: str | None = None
tools.doc:
Generate a new take on a shot in the given project (writes a veneer → real generation).

    portal_id: the project to act on (required).
    method_name: an AI model key (see the models://by-method resource). Sets the method
        (createImages/editImage/text2video/im2video/vid2vid/text2Seq/im2seq) + cost.
    shot_id: target shot; "-1" (default) appends a NEW shot to the last part.
    video_path: source video, as `take_video_path` from board://{portal_id}. REQUIRED for
        every vid2vid method_name; ignored by the other methods. Read the board and pass the
        target shot's take_video_path — do not omit it and rely on backend resolution.
    ref_images: image input(s). The FIRST entry is the source image for every method that
        transforms one; later entries are reference material.
        im2im — REQUIRED: the first entry is the image being edited.
        im2vid — the first entry is the first frame to animate. Pass it explicitly whenever
          the target shot has no take of its own to inherit, or when the user names a
          different image; the MCP routes it to its own payload slot and forwards the rest
          as references. Without it the backend has no source frame for an empty shot.
        every other method — optional reference material, no source semantics.
        The source is normally the target shot's `take_image_path` from board://{portal_id};
        use another image in the project when the user names one. Read the board and pass it
        — do not omit it and rely on backend resolution.
    style: optional. The backend appends it to the prompt text ("<prompt>, in the style of X"),
        so it only makes sense where you are describing a whole new image or video. Leave it
        unset and the project's storyboard style is applied automatically — but ONLY for a
        text2im/text2vid method with no ref_images. For every editing or animating method
        (im2im, im2vid, vid2vid) and for any call that carries ref_images, style is suppressed:
        there your prompt is an instruction about existing media, and appending a style would
        rewrite it into a request for a different picture.
        There is no composition argument. The MCP always neutralises composition, so the
        backend never prepends "Composition: mid shot." to what you wrote.
    Cost is charged to PROJECT credits; on shortfall the error explains how to fund it.
tools.summary: Generate a new take on a shot in the given project (writes a veneer → real generation).

tools.name: save_cut
tools.args: portal_id: str, high_res: bool = True, low_res: bool = False, do_export: bool = False, mute_clip_audio: bool = False
tools.doc:
Render the current sequence into a cut. Hidden parts and hidden shots are left out.

    high_res: render the high-res cut (default true).
    low_res: also render a low-res proxy cut (default false).
    do_export: also write a high-res export; requires high_res.
    mute_clip_audio: mute the clips' own audio in the render (default false).
tools.summary: Render the current sequence into a cut. Hidden parts and hidden shots are left out.

resources.doc:
One generation record: the prompt as written AND as the worker received it.

    board:// can only show the veneer joined to a shot's CURRENT take, so a generation whose
    take pointer has not advanced (every four-* text2im, which fans out into several takes) is
    invisible there. Address it by veneer_id instead — `generate` returns one.

    `expanded_prompt` is the field that matters: processVeneer rewrites the prompt as
    composition + prompt + style and hands the worker THAT (expand_prompt, functions/index.js).
resources.summary: One generation record: the prompt as written AND as the worker received it.

envVars.name: MCP_ENDPOINT
envVars.meaning: Authenticated mcpAction cloud function URL for all state reads and mutations.

envVars.name: MCP_KEY
envVars.meaning: Shared secret passed as x-mcp-key to authenticate agent calls (Director plan required).

envVars.name: MCP_UID
envVars.meaning: Acting user Firebase UID for attribution (agent:<uid>). Validated cloud-side.

envVars.name: MCP_HOST
envVars.meaning: Bind host for the FastMCP streamable-HTTP server.

envVars.name: MCP_PORT
envVars.meaning: Bind port for the FastMCP streamable-HTTP server.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.meaning: Transport protocol: streamable-http (multi-tenant SSE) or stdio (local desktop).
